merged_high_impact_suggestions.suggestion: Export predict_proba[:,1] (not predict()) from gbdt specialist into cand_gbdt.csv so NNLS blends continuous probabilities from both families. Apply threshold (>=0.5) once to blended probability to produce integer class labels for submission.

merged_high_impact_suggestions.suggestion: Add is_alone flag (family_size == 1) and fare_per_person (Fare / family_size, fold-median-filled Fare) as explicit features. Both are strong survival signals that complement existing family_size and Fare features and are fold-safe (no target used).

Add is_child binary flag (Age < 12 after fold-imputed Age) and is_large_family (family_size >= 5). These non-linear segments have distinct survival rates not fully captured by the continuous Age and family_size features.
merged_high_impact_suggestions.implementation_hint: After per-fold Age imputation: out['is_child'] = (imputed_age < 12).astype(int); out['is_large_family'] = (out['family_size'] >= 5).astype(int). Fold-safe, no target used.

merged_high_impact_suggestions.suggestion: Compute tgt_mean_title (per-fold survival rate by title group) as a per-fold aggregate alongside existing tgt_mean_Sex / tgt_mean_Pclass. Title captures finer social-status signal than ordinal encoding alone.
merged_high_impact_suggestions.implementation_hint: Inside fold loop: grp = fold_train.groupby('_title')[TARGET_COL].mean(); fold_val['tgt_mean_title'] = fold_val['_title'].map(grp).fillna(global_mean). Declare source='per_fold' in feature_spec.json.

merged_high_impact_suggestions.suggestion: Use floor canonical 5-fold OOF score (not 80/20 holdout self-reported score) as the promotion threshold in ensemble-meta so all candidates are compared apples-to-apples. Re-score oof_floor.csv against train targets using cv_folds.json fold assignments.
merged_high_impact_suggestions.implementation_hint: After floor training, re-score oof_floor.csv rows against train targets via cv_folds.json. Write that score to model_selection.json.cv_score and use it as promotion_threshold in ensemble-meta.
